answer_1.quote: Given an input sentence consisting of n characters, denoted as x = x_1 x_2 ... x_n, the goal of a CSC model is to output a corresponding correct sentence, denoted as y = y_1 y_2 ... y_n, in which all erroneous characters in x are replaced with the correct ones.
answer_1.outputs: corrected sentences with spelling errors fixed

answer_2.quote: Following the previous work, we report the precision (P), recall (R), and F1 scores at the sentence level for both subtasks. Additionally, we also evaluate the models with the False Positive Rate (FPR) metric.
